idea: Multiple QAs for acceptance gate. Today we only call one QA agent before project end. We should also call it with the other backends (only one other for now, because we have only two backends implemented). For simplicity the QAs may run serially but they are independent. The second should not just trust the first. If a QA gives feedback to spec planner then the whole loop starts again, making the project terminator and all QAs run again after implementation is done.
